method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 当天早上做了汤，晚饭时加热并配上新鲜烤面包卷。
facts.anchor: She made soup earlier that morning and heats it up for dinner along with freshly baked rolls.

facts.fact: 起初 Colm 只是隔着桌子端详 Tommy，随后两人热烈谈起分别多年的岁月。
facts.anchor: soon the two of them are talking animatedly about the years they’ve been apart.

facts.fact: 他们回到起居室，Tommy 生火，Hattie 拉下百叶窗。
facts.anchor: they return to the den, where Tommy gets the stove going.

facts.fact: Colm 说已经第三四次表示不敢相信眼前是 Tommy。
facts.anchor: Colm says for the third or fourth time.

facts.fact: Tommy 称一切超现实，并提到过去八年。
facts.anchor: Not to mention the last eight years.

facts.fact: Colm 提到超速罚单：Dustin 被摄像头拍到超速，罚单已开并已缴纳。
facts.anchor: they issued him a ticket, which he paid.

facts.fact: Tommy 说 Elle Marks 已死，无法让她辨认 Dustin。
facts.anchor: we can’t even ask her to ID him.

facts.fact: Hattie 定下圈套并亲自做诱饵，计划以从 Eeling 处得知证据为名把 Dustin 引来并录音，Colm 作额外证人。
facts.anchor: If they’re to set a trap for Dustin, she has to be the bait.
